results.title: The Roses of Marrakesh
results.overview: Leila is the devoted housekeeper of Madame Isabelle, who lives in a luxurious estate in the Palmeraie of Marrakech. Leila maintains the careful order of this timeless bubble, where everyone plays their role to perfection. Between her and Yusef, the head gardener, a tacit, quiet, and restrained friendship has formed. When Leila’s sister arrives unexpectedly, revealing a heavy secret from their past, the tranquillity of this microcosm begins to crack.

results.title: Tales from the Crypto
results.overview: As the Covid pandemic upends the global economy, a young programmer, Ravi, turns to cryptocurrency trading during the emergence of Uniswap and "DeFi Summer” to save his parents’ farm in India. But in a world rife with scammers, ruggers and naysayers, he finds that trading is much more than he bargained for

results.title: Obsessively Yours
results.overview: A socially awkward young man finds "the one" after a chance encounter at a party.

results.title: How to Wash A Body, How to Cleanse A Soul
results.original_title: How to Wash A Body, How to Cleanse A Soul
results.overview: The first time Jack ever meets Richard, his biological Dad, is two hours before Richard's funeral, where he's been asked to wash and dress the body. When Richard's lifeless body starts talking back to him, Jack realises he's got a second chance at a first meeting.

results.title: An Eye For An Eye Chart
results.original_title: An Eye For An Eye Chart
results.overview: A pregnant woman's warped vision sparks a darkly comedic revenge fantasy exposing the absurdity of medical misogyny.

results.title: The Window
results.overview: A young man arrives at a family home, where a seemingly ordinary visit takes an unexpected turn when he is drawn into a strange and unsettling story surrounding an open window. Based on Saki’s classic short story, the film explores deception, imagination and the consequences of believing what you are told.

results.title: Soulmates
results.overview: Max's plan to win over his married coworker backfires when he sneaks into her apartment and runs straight into her jealous husband. What should have been a disaster turns into an unexpected friendship, as the two men bond over their questionable romantic exploits.

results.title: Green Line
results.overview: The film opens on a tale with animated figurines in miniature settings reconstructing Fida’s childhood during the war. It then shifts to a documentary style with a series of real confrontations between Fida and ex-militiamen manipulating the small figurines. The miniature material becomes a bridge between different subjective stories, infusing the collective history with individual details. The experience of this confrontational space turns out to be cathartic. The narrative moves around between realities and temporalities.

results.title: Kin ( Short )
results.overview: Varun, a 20-year-old boy living a lavish lifestyle in Ahmedabad with his parents, is sent to the home of a family friend, Beena, in Kerala. Beena is a mysterious woman who welcomes him with her unsettling demeanor. Varun has a few secrets of his own; specifically, he has a special girlfriend named Nisha (though the details remain personal). Beena’s home contains a room that holds dark secrets about her true identity. She lies about the room, claiming it has been locked ever since her husband, David, died in a car crash because it was their shared bedroom. However, Varun later hears noises suggesting someone is inside. He shares his suspicions with Nisha, who comforts him and helps him uncover the room's secret to solve the mystery.

results.title: Changing Lanes
results.overview: Politics and planning collide in the struggle to redesign Brooklyn's notoriously dangerous McGuinness Blvd.

results.title: War of the Worlds
results.overview: Collage film built upon the audio of The War of the Worlds, directed and narrated by Orson Welles. Originally broadcast in October 1938 as a Halloween prank, the program famously triggered mass panic across the United States, as its format—presented as a series of live news bulletins—proved uncannily convincing. Absorbing the visual language of the contemporary media environment, W:A:R:O:F:T:H:E:W:O:R:L:D:S constructs a peculiar media-archaeological artifact. AI-generated videos, drone footage, feature films, video games, and online fragments converge with the original radio broadcast, creating a layered and unstable field of perception.

results.title: Marked
results.overview: Alonso takes refuge in a field, seeking to forget his past and recover from the wounds that El Merchi left him. The men he worked with begin to be murdered, Alonso returns to the city, not knowing that he has also been a target of the mafia.

results.title: Fragment of sometime, somewhere
results.overview: A young man and woman say goodbye to one another in an abstract representation of an apartment entrance. He is leaving. They struggle to separate. They exchange a piece of paper, which hints at their past together, as a farewell gift.

results.title: Never Sleep
results.overview: Following the sudden death of their father, a restless teen in the midst of a queer self-discovery bonds with their estranged aunt over their fraught relationships with death, loss and familial responsibility.

results.title: Transcend
results.overview: Trapped in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal, a woman must confront her past and herself to reclaim control of her life.

results.title: The Getaway
results.overview: On a road somewhere in Ukraine, Ana, an aid worker for a Spanish NGO, helps Yrina flee the bombings with her son, Yure. They want to reach the border as quickly as possible and get to safety.

results.title: TROPIC
results.overview: Attempting to wash her late older sister’s Hawaiian shirt, locks SUN, 23, in a space between memory and nightmare. Haunted by a tropical monster in a surreal dreamscape, Sun is forced to confront the one thing she has avoided since her sister’s death: herself.

results.title: Death of a Lion
results.overview: A  former leader in the Black Lion Party for International Solidarity shares his story of found family, loss, and transcendence. Shot over the course of two months, this short documentary provides a glimpse into the dynamics of modern American revolutionary movements. Jeremias' film captures a very brief, but important period of transition for the Black Panther Party  in the 2020s.

results.title: Tableaux
results.overview: Tableaux presents three new works by Ulrich Seidl for the Über das Leben, die Liebe und den Tod exhibition in EYE FilmMuseum in Amsterdam . Each is composed of footage originally shot for different films but never used. The material consists of so-called tableaux, a distinctive hallmark of Seidl’s visual language in which one or more of his protagonists are filmed looking directly into the camera in silence for a brief period. These images or scenes are unsettling not only because they break the ‘sacred’ fourth wall, but above all because Seidl makes the viewer complicit. The protagonists look directly into your eyes. It is as though the viewer, rather than the person on screen, is caught in the act of voyeurism. The effect is disconcerting, yet it also creates a more immediate sense of engagement with the characters.

results.title: Lero Lero 1:1 | Ten Years of Experiencing Spaces
results.original_title: Lero Lero 1:1 | Dez Anos Vivenciando Espaços
results.overview: Lero Lero, a student organization formed in 2015 at the School of Architecture and Urbanism and Design of USP, showcases a decade of work based in the idea that education extends beyond the classroom, seeking to connect students with architecture, urban planning, design and art projects at their actual scale.
